body:
Actually, what I've suggested in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/116449#issuecomment-3924042035 is not fully correct, sorry (now I've taken a look at the relevant code). It returns the center of the cell only for the default setup, i.e. when `center_x = true`, `center_y = true`, `center_z = true`. For each of these properties setting it to `false` makes the cell position "move" on the given axis to the minimum value within the grid cell's cube. Not sure how to write simply. Probably adding some examples also makes sense.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ad4c2c3da892029981707d757a80ddef12e59d7a/modules/gridmap/grid_map.cpp#L561-L568
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ad4c2c3da892029981707d757a80ddef12e59d7a/modules/gridmap/grid_map.cpp#L1342-L1347

Could be something like:
```suggestion
				Returns the position of a grid cell in the GridMap's local coordinate space. The returned position, for each axis, is either cell center or the cell edge closer to negative infinity, based on the values of [member center_x], [member center_y], [member center_z]. To convert the returned value into global coordinates, use [method Node3D.to_global]. See also [method local_to_map].
				[codeblock]
				# All examples for: cell_size = Vector2(2.0, 3.0, 4.0)

				# center_x = true, center_y = true, center_z = true
				map_to_local(Vector3i(0, 0, 0)) # Returns Vector3(1.0, 1.5, 2.0)

				# center_x = false, center_y = false, center_z = false
				map_to_local(Vector3i(0, 0, 0)) # Returns Vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)

				# center_x = true, center_y = false, center_z = true
				map_to_local(Vector3i(0, 0, 0)) # Returns Vector3(1.0, 0.0, 2.0)
				[/codeblock]
```

body:
I'm aware this is not the original PR's wording, but indeed this is quite verbose, and a bit hard to imagine.
The important part is acknowledging that these properties affect the return value. How it's done exactly _should_ be part of those properties' descriptions, ideally.
```suggestion
				Returns the position of a grid cell in the GridMap's local coordinate space. The returned position is centered according to the values of [member cell_center_x], [member cell_center_y], and [member cell_center_z]. To convert the returned value into global coordinates, use [method Node3D.to_global]. See also [method local_to_map].
```

If one would want to make this easier to picture in your head, one could write something like this, but I still think it's way too verbose (can't say I didn't try):
```suggestion
				Returns the position of a grid cell in the GridMap's local coordinate space. This position is based on the values of [member cell_center_x], [member cell_center_y], and [member cell_center_z], and it's centered on the cell's bottom-left and forward corner if all of them are [code]false[/code]. To convert the returned value into global coordinates, use [method Node3D.to_global]. See also [method local_to_map].
```
